chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ṭāhir, who said:
I was in the presence of Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), then Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) came forward, so Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) said: “This one is the best of creation, or better.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam in whose presence the event occurred
key_terms.جَعْفَرٌ: Jaʿfar, identified here as the one being praised

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) say about the rank of Jaʿfar (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) praising Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) with an expression of supreme excellence among creation. It serves as a biographical and theological indication of the elevated rank of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) within the Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, fom Tahir who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> kissed Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> is the best of the Created beings, or (even) better’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Tahir who has said the following.
“Once I was in the presence of abu Ja‘far (a.s.) when Ja‘far (a.s.) came. Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said, “This (Ja‘far ) is the best of the people or the best of best among them.”
